mapper.select: SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",COALESCE(c.CLNT_NM,'') AS "customerName", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "projectType" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=p.CUST_CLNT_ID WHERE p.PROJ_STAT_CD='ING' AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD IN ('MO','DP','TK') AND p.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} ORDER BY p.PROJ_NM,p.PROJ_ID
SELECT CODE AS "code",CODE_NM AS "name" FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID='BILL_STAT' AND USE_YN='Y' AND DEL_YN='N' ORDER BY SORT_ORD,CODE
SELECT ROLE_ID AS "code",ROLE_NM AS "name" FROM TB_SY_ROLE WHERE ROLE_ID IN ('PM','SALES_LDR','EXEC','FIN') AND USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD,ROLE_ID

SELECT p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode",a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputTypeCode", m.MON_MM AS "monthlyMm",COALESCE(m.APLY_UPRC,0) AS "billingPrice" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=m.PROJ_ID WHERE m.INPUT_YM=#{month} AND m.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD IN ('MO','DP') AND a.INPUT_TYPE_CD<>'FREE' AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' ORDER BY m.ASGN_ID
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM=#{month} AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE')

SELECT b.BILL_ID AS "billId",b.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", b.UNPAID_AMT AS "unpaidAmount",b.PAY_DUE_DT AS "payDueDate",(b.CNCL_YN='Y') AS "cancelled" FROM TB_BL_BILL b JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=b.PROJ_ID WHERE ORDER BY b.BILL_DT DESC,b.BILL_ORD DESC,b.BILL_ID DESC

SELECT h.BILL_ID AS "billId",h.DUN_SN AS "sequence",h.DUN_STEP AS "step",h.SEND_DT AS "sentDate", h.RCVR_DESC AS "recipientDescription",h.SEND_MTHD_CD AS "sendMethodCode",(h.RESEND_YN='Y') AS "resend" FROM TB_BL_DUN_HIST h JOIN TB_BL_BILL b ON b.BILL_ID=h.BILL_ID WHERE ORDER BY h.SEND_DT ASC,h.DUN_SN ASC,h.BILL_ID ASC
